6. compose create --build (build the backend image → gradle → GITHUB_TOKEN is actually needed here)
7. attachInstance
8. startAndWait (bring up all infrastructure containers)
9. Seed (sample data)
10. Dev server

- The toolchain (node, pnpm, just, docker) was all installable, and after installation all preflight checks other than GITHUB_TOKEN passed.
- The backend build-logic plugins come from a publicly accessible S3 repository (no token required).
- `io.swcode.*` artifacts all resolve to the public S3 repository — I couldn't find any external `io.swcode` maven dependencies other than the build-logic plugins.

No — the settings.gradle.kts points `io.swcode.*` to the public S3 repository `urbo-maven.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/releases`, with the comment "public, read-only S3 maven repository — no credentials required."

3. Even if I set a dummy token and got past preflight, the build requires a real token to pull packages from GitHub (per the backend/README.md). A dummy token would cause the gradle build (inside the docker image build) to fail on auth to the private registry.
